newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Campbell-Savona CSD, N.Y.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF BOND SALE
CAMPBELL-SAVONA CENTRAL SCHOOL DISTRICT
STEUBEN COUNTY, NEW YORK
GENERAL OBLIGATION SCHOOL DISTRICT (SERIAL) BONDS, 1997
(BOOK-ENTRY-ONLY) (CALLABLE) (BANK QUALIFIED)

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received and considered by the President of the Board of Education of Campbell-Savona Central School District, Steuben County, New York at the offices of Chase Investment Services Corp., Fixed Income Department, 21st Floor, One Chase Square, Rochester, New York 14643, until 11:00 A.M., Prevailing Time, on
Thursday, January 9, 1996

at which time and place the bids will be opened, for the purchase IN FEDERAL FUNDS at not less than par and accrued interest of $8,000,000 School District (Serial) Bonds, 1997, (the "Bonds"), maturing on June 15 of each year as follows:
The Bonds will be dated February 1, 1997 and will bear interest payable semi annually on June 15 and December 15 of each year commencing June 15, 1997.

The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder offering to purchase the Bonds at such rate or rates of interest as will produce the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in the Notice of Sale.
The Bonds maturing on or after June 15, 2005 are subject to redemption at the option of the School District in accordance with the terms set forth in the Notice of Sale.
The School District will designate the Bonds as "qualified tax-exempt obligations" pursuant to Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.

The Bonds will be issued by means of a book-entry-only system with The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, which will act as securities depository for the Bonds. The School District will furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of St. John & Curtin, Rochester, New York, on or about February 4, 1997.

The School District reserves the right to change the time and/or date for the opening of bids. Notice of any such change shall be provided not less than 24 hours prior to the time set forth above for the opening of bids by means of a supplemental notice of sale to be transmitted over The Munifacts Wire.
Requests for copies of the Notice of Sale herein
summarized and the Official Statement relating to the Bonds and such other information as the State Comptroller may
prescribe by rule or order may be directed to Bernar Donegan, Inc., PO Box 70, Victor, New York 14564; Phone (716) 924-2145; Fax (716) 924-4636.
Campbell, New York
Frederick Drumm
President, Board of Education
(From The Bond Buyer)
